item.kubejs.energy_plate.tooltip: An industrial component for manufacturing machines and equipment.
item.kubejs.incomplete_energy_plate.tool: Continue the filling, material assembly, and pressing steps.
item.kubejs.dimension_key.tooltip: Right-click to enter the logistics dimension; your original main-hand item is returned on arrival.
item.kubejs.gear_heart.tooltip: A supreme creation damaged by industrial curses. Inspect the active bottlenecks and break them in order with repair fragments.
item.kubejs.gear_heart_enchanted.tooltip: All seven industrial bottlenecks are broken; rotation is raised to 10,240 RPM and the Gear Heart is fully released.
item.kubejs.gear_heart_repair_fragment_1: Repair stage 1: raise the rotation limit to 512 RPM.
item.kubejs.gear_heart_repair_fragment_2: Repair stage 2: remove the Gear Heart's Create capacity quota; raise rotation to 1,024 RPM.
item.kubejs.gear_heart_repair_fragment_3: Repair stage 3: remove the Gear Heart's mineral processing rate quota; raise rotation to 2,048 RPM.
item.kubejs.gear_heart_repair_fragment_4: Repair stage 4: remove the Gear Heart's AE2 autocrafting concurrency quota; raise rotation to 4,096 RPM.
item.kubejs.gear_heart_repair_fragment_5: Repair stage 5: raise cross-process throughput from 16 to 128 items per second; raise rotation to 5,120 RPM.
item.kubejs.gear_heart_repair_fragment_6: Repair stage 6: raise active machine limits from 8 to 64; raise rotation to 8,192 RPM.
item.kubejs.gear_heart_repair_fragment_7: Repair stage 7: remove all industrial quotas and become the Unchained Gear Heart; raise rotation to 10,240 RPM.
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.blessed: The Gear Heart adds no industrial quotas; native Create, Mekanism, and AE2 limits still apply.
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.curse.rotation: Owner network rotation is limited to %s RPM
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.curse.create_c: All active Create networks owned by this player are limited to 4,096 SU total
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.curse.mek_ore_: Owned mineral processing machines are limited to 8 operations per second
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.curse.ae_craft: Owned ME networks can run at most 1 autocrafting job
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.curse.cross_pr: gear_heart:cross_process bridge items are limited to 16 items per second in Mek processing
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.curse.active_m: Active Mek processing machines and AE2 working devices are each limited to 8
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.curse.final_pr: gear_heart:final_production whitelist outputs are limited to 16 items per second
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.repaired.rotat: Rotation bottleneck broken: current repair stage allows %s RPM
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.repaired.creat: Create capacity bottleneck broken: no Gear Heart capacity quota remains
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.repaired.mek_o: Mineral processing bottleneck broken: no Gear Heart processing rate quota remains
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.repaired.ae_cr: ME concurrency bottleneck broken: no Gear Heart autocrafting concurrency quota remains
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.repaired.cross: Cross-process bottleneck broken: raised to 128 items per second
tooltip.kubejs.gear_heart.repaired.final: Final-production bottleneck broken: raised to 128 items per second
message.kubejs.gear_heart.repair.success: The repair fragment worked and broke one industrial bottleneck.
message.kubejs.gear_heart.repair.already: That industrial bottleneck is already broken. The repair fragment was not consumed.
message.kubejs.gear_heart.repair.no_targ: No equipped damaged Gear Heart was found. The repair fragment was not consumed.
message.kubejs.dimension_key.unlocked: The Dimension Key accepted your offering; the transfer dimension is permanently unlocked.
message.kubejs.dimension_key.already_unl: The transfer dimension is already permanently unlocked.
message.kubejs.dimension_key.failed: The Dimension Key could not be consumed. Please try again.
item.kubejs.crude_sulfur.tooltip: Thermally separated from sulfur-bearing volcanic material. Mill into sulfur dust.
